title: Imported: the theorems that deliver $2\pi$, and their hypotheses
subject: thermality
one_liner: Under the spectrum condition, covariance and locality, the modular flow of a wedge or half-sided algebra is the boost at rate $2\pi$, and a regular stationary quasi-free state at a bifurcate Killing horizon is KMS at $\kappa/2\pi$.

title: The blade basis persists under degeneracy
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: For any symmetric bilinear form on an $m$-dimensional real space, degenerate or not, the $2^m$ blades of any basis form a linear basis of $\Cl(W,B)$.

title: The blade basis persists under degeneracy (external ingredients)
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: The blade-basis fact draws on Chevalley's classical theory of Clifford algebras.

title: Minimal nondegenerate completion
subject: completion
one_liner: A real quadratic space with radical of dimension $r$ and nondegenerate part of signature $(p,q)$ has minimal nondegenerate completions of exactly $r$ extra dimensions, all of signature $(p+r,q+r)$ and unique up to an isometry fixing the space, so $\Cl(p,q,r)$ embeds in $\Cl(p+r,q+r)$, minimally among completion-induced embeddings.

title: The Witt extension theorem
subject: completion
one_liner: Over a field of characteristic not two, an isometry between arbitrary subspaces of two isometric nondegenerate quadratic spaces extends to an isometry of the whole spaces.

title: The Chevalley pairing
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The Chevalley pairing on the Fock module pairs the two chiralities perfectly, is antisymmetric, makes every vector self-transpose and is infinitesimally $\Spin$-invariant.

title: The chiral planes, and the summand spaces
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The two planes $\Som$, $\Spi$ of the conformal spinor space are the chiral doublets of the complexified Lorentz algebra, their tensor product is complexified Minkowski space, and each equivariant map from a direction and one plane to the other is unique up to scale.

title: The chirality split, and the ordering insensitivity of the ASD sector
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The complexified Lorentz algebra splits into commuting self-dual and anti-self-dual copies of $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\C)$, and ordering discrepancies within the anti-self-dual sector of the palatial algebra stay in that sector and never source the googly slot.

title: The Clifford side of the ordering shift
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: In the Fock model the grading element of an adjoined null pair acts on spinors as $N - \tfrac12$, with $N$ the occupation number of the corresponding mode.

title: The Fock model of the complexified ascended algebra
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The exterior algebra on a maximal isotropic subspace, with wedge and contraction operators, is the unique irreducible module of the complexified Clifford algebra $\Cl(2,4)_\C$, and its even and odd halves are the two four-dimensional chiralities.

title: Imported: complete reducibility
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: Every finite-dimensional representation of $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\C)$ is a direct sum of irreducibles, and its decomposition into isotypic components is canonical.

title: Imported: the forced completion and its fibre quadric
subject: completion
one_liner: Division by a type-N zero divisor in $\Cl(1,3)$ has no element-level resolution, its unique minimal resolving completion is $\Cl(1,3) \hookrightarrow \Cl(2,4)$, and the resolving assignments lie on the null quadric of $\R^{2,4}$.

title: Imported: ladder pairs and Fock modules over the reals
subject: tower
one_liner: Each hyperbolic pair in a real Clifford algebra gives a fermionic ladder pair, and the ladder pairs of a Witt decomposition act as a Fock module on the exterior algebra of the creation span, irreducibly when the form is split.

title: Imported: stabilisers in the flat model
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: In $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$ the stabiliser of the null vector at infinity is the Poincar\'e algebra, the stabiliser of its ray is the eleven-dimensional maximal parabolic, and its nilradical is the translations, which are the no-go theorem's transvections.

title: Imported: the vacuum equations and the scale tractor
subject: einstein
one_liner: On the invertible region of a gravitational field on flat spacetime the vacuum equations are the parallelism of the scale tractor for the tractor gauge field, and a parallel section $(1, 0, \rho)$ is exactly an Einstein scale with $\Lambda = 6\rho$ and squared norm $\Lambda/3$.

title: The incidence relation is the chart
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The Pl\"ucker bivector of the incidence line of a map $A$ is exactly the completion's null point embedding $X(m(A))$, so Penrose's incidence relation is the completion's affine chart, with a determinant as its quadratic term.

title: Lorentzian duality is a complex structure
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: On $2$-forms of an oriented four-dimensional Lorentzian space the Hodge star squares to $-1$, with three-dimensional, mutually conjugate eigenspaces for the eigenvalues $\pm I_5$ of its complexification by the central pseudoscalar $I_5$ of the odd extension.

title: One statement in three languages
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: On the invertible region of a gravitational field on flat spacetime, the vacuum and Einstein equations are equivalent to covariant constancy of the infinity bivector of the conformal spinor space, which is simple exactly when the cosmological constant vanishes.

title: Reality: the conjugation, the invariant Hermitian form, and the factor $I_6$
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The completion carries an antilinear conjugation, unique up to scale, whose invariant form on the conformal spinor space is Hermitian of signature $(2,2)$, and the real chart points are exactly the null lines of that form skew to the infinity line, with incidence relation $\omega = I_6\hat x\pi$ for Hermitian $\hat x$.

title: The shared core, and the ordering dictionary
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: Under the Klein identification, the palatial algebra's symmetrised quadratics and the Clifford bivectors share the same $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$ core acting compatibly on conformal spinors, and both storeys carry the same signed ordering shift of minus one half per dimension.

title: Skew lines, splittings, hyperbolic planes: one datum
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: An ordered pair of skew lines in the projective spinor space, a normalised splitting of the conformal spinor space into two planes and a normalised null pair in $V_\C$ determine one another, with the mixed slot equal to the orthogonal complement of the null pair.

title: The spin representation is $\mathfrak{sl}(\CS)$
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The Clifford bivectors form $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)_\C$ and act on the conformal spinor space as an isomorphism onto $\mathfrak{sl}(\CS)$, so the spin group acts on $\CS$ as all of $SL(\CS)$, transitively on nonzero conformal spinors.

title: The spinor identification
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: There is a canonical $\Spin$-equivariant isomorphism from $V_\C$ to the bivectors of the conformal spinor space carrying the quadratic form to the wedge square, so null vectors are exactly the simple bivectors, that is, the lines of the projective spinor space.

title: Symmetrised quadratics of the palatial algebra
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The symmetrised quadratics of the palatial algebra realise $\mathfrak{gl}(4,\C)$ faithfully through commutators and equal the normal-ordered ones minus the central term $\tfrac{\hbar}{2}\operatorname{tr}M$, a shift of $-2\hbar$ for the helicity generator.

title: Conformal spinors are the states of three ladder pairs
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: Every nonzero conformal spinor is a pure spinor, the Fock vacuum of the three fermionic ladder pairs fixed by its annihilator, so conformal spinors are states of the pair algebra and not its operators.

title: The acoustic no-go: one way to grip
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: In a state invariant under the gauge group, charge conjugation and the modular flow, every gauge-charged or charge-conjugation-odd probe has zero linear overlap with the graviton mode $T$, so only the neutral, charge-conjugation-even sector can couple at first order.

title: The conclusion does not depend on the ontology, at its level
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: The conclusion that stress-energy is the only coupling sector at first order holds on both the composite and the fundamental reading of the graviton, at the levels each branch carries: on the composite reading proved in the s-wave sector with an assembled lift, on the fundamental reading at leading order only.

title: The four alternatives are exhaustive; the three are not
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: Every conserved quantity is exactly one of dynamically fixed, a parameter of the laws or initial data, with being kinematic excluded by none of these (implied by the first, compatible with the other two and with its negation), so excluding kinematic and dynamical leaves initial data only if parameters of the laws are excluded.

title: The frozen point makes the Stelle-West vector
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: On the Einstein region with $\Lambda\neq 0$ the frozen point reduces the ambient structure to de Sitter or anti-de Sitter type and, with the canonical tractor, supplies the Stelle-West vector $V = X - (3/\Lambda)I$, so the MacDowell-Mansouri action is $Q(I)^{-1}\int\epsilon(I,V,F,F)$, polynomial and free of inverse metrics.

title: Imported: conformal orthogonality, and the Sugawara construction
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: In two-dimensional conformal field theory, quasi-primaries of unequal dimension are orthogonal in the conformal vacuum, and a current algebra's stress tensor is the Sugawara bilinear of its currents.

title: Imported: the frozen point and its geometry
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: On the invertible region of a gravitational field on flat spacetime the Einstein condition makes the scale tractor parallel for the tractor connection, with $Q(I) = \Lambda/3$, stabiliser $SO(1,4)$ or $SO(2,3)$, and $P_{ab} = (\Lambda/6)g_{ab}$.

title: Imported: the frozen point and its geometry (external ingredients)
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: The frozen-point fact takes its tractor connection and almost-Einstein scale tractor from Gover's work on almost-Einstein manifolds.

title: Imported: the Henneaux-Teitelboim promotion
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: In the Henneaux-Teitelboim unimodular formulation of general relativity, $\Lambda$ is a constant of integration fixed by an equation of motion rather than a parameter of the action.

title: Imported: the MacDowell-Mansouri theorem, Stelle-West form
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: The MacDowell-Mansouri functional of a de Sitter gauge field $A(a) = \Omega(a) - \hb^{-1}(a)\wedge V/\ell^2$ on flat spacetime, with a Stelle-West vector of fixed norm, splits into Gauss-Bonnet, Einstein-Cartan and cosmological terms, and its field equations are the Einstein-Cartan equations with cosmological constant $\Lambda$.

title: Imported: the s-wave current algebra
subject: thermality
one_liner: The boundary modes' number-conserving bilinears form an exact free-boson current algebra up to explicit edge terms, and under premise (Q) the induced current state is KMS at the $\TH$-analogue temperature.

title: Imported: the s-wave current algebra (external ingredients)
subject: thermality
one_liner: The boson-fermion correspondence, cited from Pressley and Segal, identifies the charge-zero fermionic Fock space with the bosonic Fock space.

title: Imported: walls, and the sphere theorem
subject: walls
one_liner: At a tame corank-one wall the Clifford sheaf continues, the metric has a simple pole with $\mathcal{L}^{\otimes 2} \cong N^*\Sigma$, the completion adjoins a Witt partner of the radical covector, and, under the Indifference principle, the transverse sphere is carried by boundary-mode bilinears.

title: The lift inherits the no-go, with its steps itemised
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: At assembly level and conditional on the Indifference premise, the four-dimensional lift inherits the acoustic no-go: near the horizon the angular modes carry nonzero spin and decouple from $T$ in an $\mathfrak{su}(2)$-invariant state, and elsewhere classical general relativity couples to stress-energy alone.

title: The point at infinity has no physical fluctuation: the $(I,V)$-sector is pure gauge
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: Within the three-argument variational principle, the constrained fluctuations of $(I,V)$ and the broken generators of $SO(2,4)$ both number nine and correspond bijectively, so the $(I,V)$-sector is pure gauge and the graviton has no $(\delta I,\delta V)$ polarisation.

title: The Stelle-West vector of the frozen point
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: In the frozen point's scale, $V = X - (3/\Lambda)I$ is orthogonal to $I$ with $Q(V) = -3/\Lambda$ and $\nabla V = e$, and the tractor gauge field is $\Omega(a) + \hb^{-1}(a)\wedge V/Q(V)$.

title: Under the action as written, the norm is a parameter of the laws
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: Under the action as written, $N = M_P\sqrt{3/\Lambda}$ is constant on each solution space and varies with $\Lambda$, so it is a parameter of the laws and not initial data.

title: The asymmetry: the arrow counted, and the fifteenth refutation
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: The framework inherits rather than generates its asymmetry, which is confined to this tower and the mirror, with a common value under premise P4; a constant early $\theta$-angle as its source is excluded by the neutron dipole bound, and, on a flagged stance, the value $\epsilon$ is assumed to be initial data of the descent.

title: The ceiling valued, and an inherited success
subject: neutrinos
one_liner: Under Hypothesis (U), read at a common low scale, the seesaw values the rung scale between $m_{b}^{2}/m_{3} \approx 3.5 \times 10^{11}$ GeV and $m_{t}^{2}/m_{3} \approx 6 \times 10^{14}$ GeV.

title: The coefficients, the floors they give, and what gravity cannot supply
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: At the ceiling reheating, graviton-mediated heating gives temperature floors of a few times $10^{-4}$ for the mirror and, for that light content, a nine-vector five-dimensional tower, but falls $3$ to $5 \times 10^{4}$ short of the mirror's charge, so gravity heats the dark towers without populating them.

title: The flag bit exists exactly at tower dimension $0 \bmod 4$
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: The choice between the two halves of a Witt pair is a bit of the connected conformal spin group exactly when the tower dimension is $0 \bmod 4$, so, under Premise P3 (nearest-dimension representatives), the even residues can be oriented, and the odd residues never can.

title: The flag is insensitive to the residue: no flag-level strengthening
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Witt's theorem makes the descent's flag equally uncaused in every nondefinite representative, so no flag-level strengthening of the tower count exists and the exclusion of residue $0$ rests on the two-time instability import alone.

title: Hypothesis (U): equal rank-one eigenvalues at the ceiling
subject: neutrinos
one_liner: Premise (U): the rank-one eigenvalues of the fermion sectors coincide at the ceiling, so the neutrino's Dirac eigenvalue there is the common leading-order value.

title: Imported: the derived generation and the flag
subject: standard-model
one_liner: Under Hypothesis (S), the derived generation's three-pair Witt structure carries a one-handed listing choice, the particle-antiparticle orientation, which the dark-matter paper reads as the descent's flag.

title: Imported: the eight towers and the mod-8 clock
subject: tower
one_liner: The $(1,1)$ ascent preserves $p - q$ with $\Cl(p+k,q+k) \cong \Mat(2^{k}, \Cl(p,q))$, so the eight residues of $p - q$ modulo eight label eight parallel towers.

title: Gravity-only coupling at first order, restated from the acoustic no-go
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Under the Indifference premise and premise (Q), matter that gravitates on this metric and shares no gauge charge with us acts on us through the metric-forming correlations only through its stress-energy, at first order, by the series' acoustic no-go restated; with P1 it does nothing else observable at that order.

title: Imported: the inputs of the Standard-Model chain
subject: standard-model
one_liner: The Standard-Model chain of the series uses exactly a stated list of inputs, from the conformal completion and its conformal spinor ideal to the mass formula, pair-counting hypercharge, Hypothesis (S) and signature-free imports, a list carried as a hypothesis.

title: Imported: the massless-graviton production rate
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Graviton exchange from the Standard-Model plasma produces a species at rate $\alpha T^{8}/\bar{M}_{P}^{4}$, with $\alpha$ of order $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-3}$ for scalars, fermions and vectors.

title: Imported: Schwinger discharge of a charged hole
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: A charged hole discharges by pair creation toward $Q_{c} = 4\pi\varepsilon_{0}E_{c}r_{+}^{2}$, which limits its charge below about $1.3 \times 10^{5}$ solar masses and not above.

title: Imported: the trichotomy and the descent's data
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: The number $N = M_P/H$ is not dynamical and, at observation level, not kinematic, and under the action as written it is a parameter of the laws rather than initial data, which qualifies each place the dark-matter paper calls a datum initial data of the descent.

title: The mirror tower is a copy of this one
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Every input of the Standard-Model chain is invariant under signature reversal, so the mirror tower carries a copy of the derived Standard Model and, with a common ceiling $M$ and equal couplings there (the common-ceiling-coupling premise) and under the single frozen point and indifference (which discharge the democracy premise for the mirror), $\Omega_{\mathrm{mirror}} = \Omega_{b}$ to half a percent; indifference at its first reach would also make the mirror as hot as ours, and as scoped it leaves the temperature free.

title: The open channels, with their costs
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: The mirror tower adds $\Delta N_{\mathrm{eff}} = 7.447\,(T'/T_{\gamma})^{4}$, safe below $T'/T_{\gamma} = 0.448$, while a five-dimensional tower's light abelian species stays under the cap only if one of three unproved routes closes it.

title: P1: the single frozen point
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: the descent was one event, so all towers share one metric and, where they can be oriented, one Witt flag.

title: P2: indifference, scoped to sector labels
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: the descent equates towers only along the reversal orbit $r \mapsto -r$, the one symmetry of the soldered residues, and it equates sector labels such as the tower charge, not thermal states, over a finite deposited mode set.

title: P3: nearest-dimension representatives
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: each tower is represented at the dimension nearest four, ties going to the lower dimension when it has a single time.

title: P4: democracy of the asymmetry over the oriented towers
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: the flag imprints the same asymmetry $\epsilon$ per mode on every oriented tower.

title: P5: boundary modes hold entropy, not global charge
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: black-hole boundary modes return information and Gauss-law charges but not global charges such as baryon number.

title: Parallel boundary mode spaces at one wall: the infall computation
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Under P1, P5, the interface premise and the imported exhaustiveness premise, what any tower drops into a black hole returns its energy democratically to all towers and its information to its own, but not its global charges, and leaves no remnant.

title: R1: equal mass per quantum
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: the quanta of every populated tower carry the same mass $m$.

title: R2: one quantum per unit ball
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: each populated tower holds one quantum per unit ball of its space, with one Wigner-Seitz radius common to all towers.

title: R3: one cell per unshared direction
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise: in the sourcing rule a tower's matter counts through exactly one cell radius of each direction its neighbour lacks.

title: The residue is a soldered invariant, not an algebraic one
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: The residue is preserved by every isomorphism carrying vectors to vectors, but not by abstract algebra isomorphisms, under which residues $0$ and $2$, $3$ and $7$, and $4$ and $6$ coincide at equal dimension.

title: Seeding by gravity: the floor on a dark tower's temperature
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Gravitational production from the visible plasma, at the imported rate, puts a floor $\xi_{\mathrm{floor}} \propto c^{1/4}T_{\mathrm{desc}}^{3/4}$ on the temperature ratio of a dark tower whose light species thermalise among themselves, $9.6 \times 10^{-4}\,c^{1/4}(16/g_{d})^{1/4}$ at the ceiling reheating.

title: The stored asymmetry is a charge, not a number
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Under the inherited-asymmetry classification, with the number $N$ (which fixes a count of registered units) common to the towers under P1, an oriented tower's asymmetry is the temperature-independent charge $Q = \epsilon N$, so the mirror share $f_{2} = 1$ holds at any mirror temperature.

title: Superselected, hence dark and exactly stable
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Under P1, the sector decomposition and the wall-sequence theorem's hypotheses (compact base, good couplings), the tower charge is exactly superselected, so dark-tower matter is exactly stable; that it only gravitates, at first order, is the series' acoustic no-go's, within the s-wave current algebra and conditional on the Indifference premise and premise (Q).

title: Towers are residues, and the single-clock filter
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: The residue $p - q \pmod 8$ is invariant along each tower, and under the nearest-dimension premise P3, with P2 reading the time-sign label as indexical, exactly the residues $0$ and $4$ lack a single time direction, leaving six towers that admit matter (the two-time exclusion imports the standard instability).

title: The two families are the two chiralities
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: In even dimension $2m$ maximal isotropic subspaces fall into exactly two families, labelled by the chirality of their pure spinors, with a Witt pair in opposite families exactly when $m$ is odd; in odd dimension there is one family.

title: Type by residue, and what each tower can carry intrinsically
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: A tower's spinor type (real, complex or quaternionic, with one or two modules) is a function of its residue alone, and it fixes the intrinsic symmetry group, $\Z_{2}$, $U(1)$ or $Sp(1)$, that each tower's ground algebra carries.

title: The unit-ball rule
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Under premises R1 to R3 a tower with $D$-dimensional space has share $V_{3}/V_{D}$, and the dark-to-baryon ratio is $(11\pi + 16)/(3\pi) \approx 5.3643$, against the observed $5.364 \pm 0.065$, an agreement built in by fitting, not predicted.

title: The adjoint and the norm of the field
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: In a causal tower the adjoint $e_t\rev{x}e_t^{-1}$ is the standard conjugation on the corner field, with positive norm $N(x)$, and $j(\psi x) = N(x)\,j(\psi)$.

title: The constituent's field in each tower
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: In tower $r$ the constituent's field, at the conformal and the tower level alike, is the division algebra of residue $r + 1$: $\C$, $\R$ or $\HH$ as the causal tower's dimension is four, three or five.

title: Premise H1: a constituent's momentum
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Premise H1: a constituent's momentum is the vector part of $\psi e_t\rev{\psi}$ for its spinor part $\psi \in S$, linked to $T$ by a spin-intertwining map; a premise in dimensions three and five.

title: Imported: the structure of real Clifford algebras
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Imported: $\Cl^0(p,q) \cong \Cl(p,q-1)$, $\Cl(p,q)$ is a matrix algebra over $\R$, $\C$ or $\HH$ fixed by $p - q \bmod 8$, and a minimal left ideal's commutant is the division algebra $(fAf)^{\mathrm{op}}$.

title: Where mass begins in each causal tower
subject: dark-matter
one_liner: Mass begins at two constituents in dimensions three and four, where the reversion pairing is alternating, and at one constituent in dimension five, and total momenta are never spacelike.

title: The alignment computed: the thirteenth refutation, democracy, and one heavy family
subject: generations
one_liner: The $\Lambda$-suppressed source cannot set the weak scale, but its direction, democratic under the indifference instrument, gives under the Gram-square reading a rank-one mass form with one heavy and two light families at leading order.

title: Imported: the dictionary and the exact join
subject: mass
one_liner: Mass is weight read against the frozen point, $m^{2} = -w(w+3)H^{2}$, and for two conformal spinors $m^{2} = 2|B_{\Lambda}|^{2} + \Lambda C/3$, which puts a heavy composite's mass in the imaginary part of its weight.

title: Imported: the face-valued bracket and its quantum numbers
subject: mass
one_liner: The mass bracket transforms by $\det(U)$ under the internal $U(2)$ and carries the quantum numbers $(1,1)$ with $Y = +1$ of $e^{c}$, not those of a weak doublet.

title: Imported: the indifference instrument
subject: programme
one_liner: On the families paper's reading, indifference, a structural premise, equates weights only along symmetry orbits and never equates inequivalent irreducible components.

title: The source term: the $\Lambda$-linear tilt of the mass functional
subject: generations
one_liner: The $\Lambda$-deformed join contains a term linear in the flat bracket, so under the observation-level reading that the potential is built on the mass functional with $b$ and the vacuum $\omega$-area independent, the potential tilts and condensation is unavoidable unless that area vanishes.

title: Imported: the tower and its limit
subject: quantum-fields
one_liner: The tower planes generate the CAR, $\{v_j, w_k\} = \delta_{jk}$ with $Q(v_j) = Q(w_j) = 0$, and the tower's limit is the CAR algebra.

title: Second quantisation
subject: quantum-fields
one_liner: With the single-algebra field and the unit $I_4$, second quantisation gives a local field and the standard $d\Gamma(M)$, one chirality entering complex-linearly and the other conjugated.

title: Where each imaginary unit lives
subject: quantum-fields
one_liner: In real geometric algebra the conformal spinors' unit is $\pm I_6 = \pm I_4E$, equal to $\pm I_4$ on the two chiral doublets, and a massless field's unit is $\pm I_4$, with which a mass term anticommutes.

title: The current commutator, exactly, with its edge split
subject: thermality
one_liner: On a finite window the current commutator is exactly $[a_{m}, a_{m}^{\dagger}] = B_{m} - T_{m}$, a difference of edge occupations, so the free-boson relation holds exactly on edge-clean states.

title: Gibbs states are KMS, and conversely, in finite dimensions
subject: descent
one_liner: On a full matrix algebra with dynamics generated by a diagonal Hamiltonian, the Gibbs state at inverse temperature $\beta$ is KMS, and it is the unique KMS state at that $\beta$, degenerate spectrum included.

title: Greybody inheritance, under the interface premise
subject: thermality
one_liner: Under the interface premise (I), and premise (Q) for the bosonic sector, the framework's emitted flux in each channel is $\tfrac{1}{2\pi}\Gamma_{s\ell m}(\omega)\,n_{\pm}(\omega)$ at $\TH$, Hawking's greybody-filtered spectrum.

title: The helicity lift, with its joints itemised
subject: thermality
one_liner: Under the modelling joint J3 (its channel reduction assumed for even-parity spin $2$ only, derived for lower spins and for odd-parity spin $2$), helicity is the eigenvalue of the conformal storey's distinguished $\mathfrak{u}(1)$ charge, with helicity $s$ at Penrose homogeneity $-2s-2$.

title: The homogeneity $-2s-2$ is the ordering shift
subject: thermality
one_liner: In the symmetric ordering $q(\id) = -\hbar(\Upsilon + 2)$, so a function on the conformal spinor space of homogeneity $\mathsf{h}$ has helicity $s$ exactly when $\mathsf{h} = -2s - 2$, the $-2$ being the ordering shift.

title: The I-state
subject: thermality
one_liner: At the Hawking temperature the Fermi-Dirac quasi-free state on the boundary-mode algebra is KMS for the boost dynamics, and it is the only quasi-free state that is, with gauge invariance and its symbol both forced.

title: The I-state on the continuum
subject: thermality
one_liner: On the continuum mode space at $\beta = 2\pi/\kappa$, for any self-adjoint $h$, the quasi-free state with symbol $(1 + e^{\beta h})^{-1}$ is $\tau$-KMS and is the unique $\tau$-KMS state.

title: Imported: the exterior is exactly general relativity
subject: einstein
one_liner: Where the gauge field is invertible and $\Lambda = 0$, the series' description coincides exactly with general relativity, its vacuum equations being the parallelism of the scale tractor.

title: Imported: ideal-Fermi-gas uniqueness
subject: descent
one_liner: For free fermions with quasi-free dynamics the $\beta$-KMS state is unique and is the quasi-free state with Fermi-Dirac symbol $(1 + e^{\beta h})^{-1}$.

title: Imported: KMS passes to inductive limits
subject: descent
one_liner: A state that is KMS at $\beta$ on each subalgebra of an increasing chain of dynamics-invariant subalgebras is KMS at $\beta$ on the closure of their union.

title: Imported: modular descent, its premises, and the geometric normalisation
subject: descent
one_liner: A pure, boost-invariant, entangling state of a horizon pair descends to a KMS state at an undetermined temperature, which the premises (P) and (R) fix as Fermi-Dirac at the Hawking temperature $\TH = 1/8\pi M$.

title: Imported: modular descent and its geometric normalisation (external)
subject: descent
one_liner: The wedge-modular theorem of Bisognano and Wichmann, Sewell's black-hole reading of it, and Israel's thermofield reading of the eternal black hole.

title: Imported: the Penrose transform
subject: thermality
one_liner: Massless free fields of helicity $s$ correspond naturally to first cohomology on regions of the conformal spinor space with coefficients in $\mathcal{O}(-2s-2)$.

title: Imported: quasi-free KMS reduces to the two-point level
subject: descent
one_liner: A gauge-invariant quasi-free CAR state is KMS for quasi-free dynamics exactly when its two-point function satisfies the two-point KMS identity.

title: Imported: quasi-free states of the CAR algebra
subject: thermality
one_liner: Each symbol $0 \le A \le 1$ determines a unique gauge-invariant quasi-free state of the CAR algebra; quasi-free states are fixed by their symbol and pairing, and gauge invariance is the vanishing of the pairing.

title: Imported: the s-wave bosonic sector
subject: thermality
one_liner: Boundary-mode currents satisfy the free-boson relations exactly up to an edge term, and under Premise (Q) they carry Bose-Einstein occupancy at $\TH$ in the s-wave sector.

title: Imported: the s-wave bosonic sector (external ingredients)
subject: thermality
one_liner: The outside ingredient of the imported s-wave bosonic sector is the classical boson-fermion correspondence of Frenkel and Kac (1980).

title: Imported: the conformal storey (twistor storey), and the ordering shift
subject: thermality
one_liner: The spinor module of $\Cl(2,4)$ is the conformal spinor space, and symmetric ordering shifts its $\mathfrak{u}(1)$ charge by $-\hbar/2$ per complex dimension, matching the shift of $-\tfrac12$ per fermionic mode on the Clifford storey.

title: Joint J3: the partial-wave reduction (modelling)
subject: thermality
one_liner: Premise: the current boson of the s-wave theory is each partial-wave channel, $\ell \geq |s|$, of each massless field on the Schwarzschild exterior (an identification that is not one array tower per helicity channel), and each even-parity $(\omega, \ell, m)$ channel of the spin-$2$ field is a two-dimensional boundary mode (for spins $0$, $\tfrac12$, $1$ and for odd-parity spin $2$ that channel reduction is derived).

title: KMS restricts to invariant subalgebras
subject: descent
one_liner: A KMS state restricts to a KMS state at the same inverse temperature on any unital subalgebra invariant under the dynamics.

title: Modular structure of the completed pair
subject: descent
one_liner: The completed pair's bivector $\sigma = v^{*}v - vv^{*}$ is a unit boost whose rotor flow scales the pair with opposite weights, whose spectral projectors are the occupation projectors, and which is unique up to reparametrisation and orientation.

title: Premise (I): the interface identification
subject: thermality
one_liner: Premise: the occupancy of each near-horizon channel is carried to the corresponding asymptotic channel by the exterior propagation.

title: The boosts generate exactly the Levi factor
subject: einstein
one_liner: The three boosts generate exactly the six-dimensional Lorentz algebra $\Lambda^2 W \cong \mathfrak{so}(1,3)$, with no component outside it.

title: Covariant form of the vacuum equations
subject: einstein
one_liner: On the invertible region of a gravitational field on flat spacetime, the vacuum field equations hold exactly when the null scale tractor $\nInf$ of the derived metric is parallel for the tractor gauge field $\Omega_{T}$.

title: Exact parallelism, and the convergence rate
subject: interior
one_liner: In the Schwarzschild interior the adapted physical frame is exactly $D$-parallel along the infalling free-fall worldlines, and the Hubble-normalised expansion rates reach the Kasner exponents $(-\tfrac13, \tfrac23, \tfrac23)$ at the single, non-oscillating rate $O(\tau^{2/3})$.

title: Imported: equivalence with the Einstein equations
subject: einstein
one_liner: Wherever $\hb$ is invertible, the GTG field equations are equivalent to Einstein's equations for the induced metric, and in vacuum to its Ricci-flatness.

title: Imported: the Schwarzschild curvature spectrum
subject: einstein
one_liner: The curvature operator $\mathcal{R}(B)$ of the Schwarzschild field is diagonal in the static frame, with eigenvalue $2M/r^3$ on the radial plane and its dual and $-M/r^3$ on the four mixed planes.

title: Imported: the Schwarzschild curvature spectrum (external ingredients)
subject: einstein
one_liner: The outside source for the Schwarzschild curvature spectrum is Doran and Lasenby, Geometric Algebra for Physicists, chapter 14.

title: Imported: the tractor connection
subject: einstein
one_liner: For a gravitational field on flat spacetime, the tractor bundle of its conformal class (the $\Cl(2,4)$ vectors $\sigma\nInf + \mu + \rho\nO$) carries a canonical metric-preserving connection, given in a chosen scale by an explicit formula involving the Schouten tensor.

title: The interior connection, exactly
subject: interior
one_liner: In the parallel frame of the Schwarzschild interior the rotation-gauge field $\Omega$ is exactly $-\sigma_i B_i$ on each unit tangential direction, plus the round-sphere rotation $(\cot\theta/r)R_{23}$ on $e_3$, with $\Omega(e_0) = 0$.

title: Kasner form of the interior
subject: interior
one_liner: In proper time $\tau$ the derived metric of the Schwarzschild interior field is synchronous and diagonal, with Kasner exponents $(-\tfrac13, \tfrac23, \tfrac23)$ to leading order and explicit series corrections.

title: Metric parallelism, and the trace of the Schouten condition
subject: einstein
one_liner: The tractor gauge field preserves the tractor metric, and a Schouten map proportional to the identity forces the factor to be $R/24$ and the field to be Einstein, so $\Sch = 0$ exactly when $\Ric = 0$.

title: Non-null stabilisers, and the section they act on
subject: einstein
one_liner: A non-null vector $I$ has the reductive ten-dimensional stabiliser $\mathfrak{so}(I^\perp)$, and its hyperplane section of the null quadric is de Sitter or anti-de Sitter space according to the sign of $Q(I)$.

title: $\Lambda \neq 0$: the scale tractor leaves the cone
subject: einstein
one_liner: For a gravitational field whose derived metric is Einstein with constant $\Lambda$, the section $\nInf + \tfrac{\Lambda}{6}\nO$ is parallel, every parallel section $(1, 0, \rho)$ arises this way, and its squared norm is $\Lambda/3$.

title: The sign is fixed internally
subject: einstein
one_liner: Within the series' conventions, the sign of the Schouten term of the tractor gauge field is forced by requiring that $\Lambda > 0$ give the de Sitter section.

title: The stabiliser rotates from parabolic to reductive
subject: einstein
one_liner: The stabiliser of the frozen point is the Poincar\'e group for $\Lambda = 0$, the de Sitter group $SO(1,4)$ for $\Lambda > 0$ and the anti-de Sitter group $SO(2,3)$ for $\Lambda < 0$.

title: Stabilisers in the flat model
subject: einstein
one_liner: In the flat model the stabiliser of the null vector $\nInf$ is the Poincar\'e algebra, that of its ray is the eleven-dimensional maximal parabolic, and the nilradical acts as translations through null shears.

title: The chart form of the spin isomorphism
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: In the conformal spinor chart, the dilation, the translations and the special conformal generators correspond to the grading element and to the maps $b_x: \Spi \to \Som$ and $c_x: \Som \to \Spi$ between the chiral halves.

title: The de Sitter scale and its frozen point
subject: dark-energy
one_liner: On flat spacetime de Sitter space is the gravitational field $\hb = \sigma$, $\sigma = 1 - \Lambda Q(x)/12$, with derived metric $\sigma^{-2}\eta$, and its frozen point is the unique constant vector $I_\Lambda = n_\infty + (\Lambda/6)n_0$, of squared norm $\Lambda/3$, which is the point at infinity $n_\infty$ at $\Lambda = 0$.

title: The exact join
subject: mass
one_liner: For two conformal spinors the grip on the frozen point has $m^{2} = 2|B_{\Lambda}|^{2} + \tfrac{\Lambda}{3}C$, with $B_{\Lambda} = \br{\pi^{1}\pi^{2}} + \tfrac{\Lambda}{6}[\omega^{1}\omega^{2}]$.

title: Imported: the flat model, the conformal spinor chart, and the infinity bivector
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: Imported: on the flat model the point embedding is null, $V_\C = \Lambda^2\CS$ with null meaning simple, $\mathfrak{sl}(\CS) \cong \so(\Lambda^2\CS, \varepsilon)$, and for $\Lambda = 0$ the infinity bivector is constant and simple.

title: Imported: flat model, conformal spinor chart and infinity bivector (external)
subject: conformal-spacetime
one_liner: The external ingredients of the flat-model fact: the conformal tractor dictionary of Bailey, Eastwood and Gover, and classical spinor material from Penrose and Rindler and from Hughston.

title: Imported: the frozen point and the tractor connection
subject: einstein
one_liner: For a vacuum Einstein field on flat spacetime the tractor gauge field has a parallel frozen point $I = \nInf + \tfrac{\Lambda}{6}\nO$ of squared norm $\Lambda/3$, with stabiliser $SO(1,4)$ for $\Lambda > 0$.

title: Imported: the Thomas operator
subject: einstein
one_liner: The Thomas operator sends a weight-$w$ density to a conformally invariant tractor, and at $w = 1$ it produces the scale tractor, which is the frozen point for an Einstein scale.

title: Imported: the unitary representations of the de Sitter group
subject: mass
one_liner: The scalar unitary representations of $SO(1,4)$, with $m^{2} = \Delta(3-\Delta)H^{2}$, comprise the principal series ($m^{2} \ge \tfrac94 H^{2}$), the complementary series ($0 < m^{2} < \tfrac94 H^{2}$) and the massless point, none with $m^{2} < 0$.

title: Mass as symplectic area: the two-spinor formula
subject: mass
one_liner: Two conformal spinors with momentum $\pi^{1}\bar\pi^{1} + \pi^{2}\bar\pi^{2}$ have $m^{2} = 2|\br{\pi^{1}\pi^{2}}|^{2}$, the squared symplectic area of their spinor parts.

title: The mass-weight dictionary
subject: mass
one_liner: A density of weight $w$ with $I \cdot D\sigma = 0$ obeys the Klein-Gordon equation with $m^{2} = -w(w+3)H^{2}$ in four dimensions.

title: The weight of a composite
subject: mass
one_liner: For $\Lambda > 0$ the induced weight of a composite of two conformal spinors is $w = -\tfrac32 \pm I_4\nu$ (numbers are read in $\mathrm{span}\{1, I_4\}$) with $\nu^{2} = 6|B_{\Lambda}|^{2}/\Lambda + C - \tfrac94$, so a composite heavier than $3H/2$ carries its mass in $\mathrm{Im}\,w$, which at leading order is $\sqrt{2}\,|B_{\Lambda}|/H$ when $|B_{\Lambda}| \gg H\sqrt{C}$.

title: The weight polynomial and the two series
subject: mass
one_liner: Under $m^{2} = -w(w+3)H^{2}$, real weights give $0 \le m \le 3H/2$ exactly on $[-3, 0]$, and $m > 3H/2$ needs $w = -\tfrac32 \pm I_4\nu$ (numbers are read in $\mathrm{span}\{1, I_4\}$), the principal series.

title: Doubling or complexification
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: An odd-dimensional $\Cl(p,q)$ is two copies of its even subalgebra when $\omega^{2} = +1$ and that subalgebra complexified when $\omega^{2} = -1$, and the even subalgebra is a Clifford algebra of one dimension fewer.

title: The volume element in odd dimension
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: In odd dimension $n$ the volume element of $\Cl(p,q)$ is central with $\omega^{2} = (-1)^{n(n-1)/2 + q}$, which is $(-1)^{q}$ for $n = 5$.

title: Imported: the Weyl scalars, and the Petrov type of Schwarzschild
subject: einstein
one_liner: The Weyl map of the field strength has five complex null-tetrad components $\Psi_0, \dots, \Psi_4$, and the Schwarzschild field is of Petrov type D with only $\Psi_2 = -M/r^3$ nonzero, its repeated principal directions radial.

title: The centre
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: For $n \geq 1$ the centre of $\Cl(p,q)$ is $\R \cdot 1$ when $n$ is even and $\R \cdot 1 \oplus \R \cdot \omega$ when $n$ is odd.

title: Classification of the real Clifford algebras
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: $\Cl(p,q)$ is a matrix algebra over $\R$, $\C$ or $\HH$, or a sum of two such, according to $p - q \bmod 8$, and it is simple except when $p - q \equiv 1 \pmod 4$.

title: The commutation rule
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: If $x$ lies in the subalgebra generated by vectors orthogonal to $v$, then $v x = \hat{x} v$ and $x v = v \hat{x}$.

title: The sign of $\omega^2$
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: The pseudoscalar of $\Cl(p,q)$ satisfies $\omega^{2} = (-1)^{(p-q)(p-q-1)/2}$, so $\omega^{2} = +1$ exactly when $p - q \equiv 0$ or $1 \pmod 4$.

title: Splitting along a hyperbolic plane
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: Along a hyperbolic plane spanned by a null pair $(v, w_0)$, every element of $\Cl(H_0 \perp U')$ expands uniquely as $\alpha + v\beta + w_0\gamma + v w_0\delta$ with coefficients in $\Cl(U')$, and left multiplication by $v$ is injective on $\Cl(U')$.

title: The twisted adjoint action
subject: standard-algebra
one_liner: The twisted adjoint action of a versor is an algebra automorphism acting on vectors by hyperplane reflections, giving a two-to-one map of $\Pin(p,q)$ onto $\mathrm{O}(p,q)$.

title: Imported: classification, the centre, and type C (external ingredients)
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: The collected classification facts draw on the classical classification table of real Clifford algebras (Atiyah, Bott and Shapiro; Lounesto).

title: The area-law test
subject: entropy
one_liner: The mode count equals $\SBH = 4\pi M^2$ if and only if $\nu\,\Delta t = M/2$ (in the 1-nat convention; $M/(2\ln 2)$ when each mode is credited its $\ln 2$), an epoch of order one Schwarzschild time.

title: The boundary mode space as matrix
subject: entropy
one_liner: The bilinears $\psi_i^\dagger\psi_j$ of $n$ completed boundary-mode pairs obey the $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$ relations and restrict on the one-particle subspace onto the full matrix algebra $\Mat_n$.

title: The clock inventory of the boundary modes
subject: entropy
one_liner: Every clock of the boundary modes runs at the modular rate $\kappa$, so every one has period $\beta = 2\pi/\kappa = 8\pi M$.

title: Consistency with the CAR construction, and the I-state's insensitivity
subject: thermality
one_liner: At assembly level the sphere's symmetry commutes with the modular clock; the mixed bilinears are ordinary CAR bilinears of the boundary modes; and, within the quasi-free setting, the I-state, whose symbol is a function of the one-particle Hamiltonian, is invariant under every gauge Bogoliubov transformation commuting with it, including all embedded $SU(2)$ actions.

title: The epoch is the modular period; two unknowns become one
subject: entropy
one_liner: Under the intrinsic-clock premise the counted epoch is the modular period $\beta = 8\pi M$, turning the area law into the prediction $\nu = 1/16\pi$ in the 1-nat convention.

title: Imported: the collar's coframe at the exceptional set, and the helicity lift
subject: interior
one_liner: The horizon-normalised weighted coframe on the Schwarzschild exceptional set is exactly $(dt, r_h\,d\theta, r_h\sin\theta\,d\varphi)$, and the two helicities of a massless species enter as two channels at homogeneities $-2s-2$, at modelling tier.

title: Imported: Kostant, Madore, and the $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ partition data
subject: entropy
one_liner: Embeddings of $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ in $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ are classified by partitions of $n$; the principal one decomposes $\Mat_n$ without multiplicity and makes it Madore's fuzzy sphere, tending to the round $S^2$.

title: Imported: the mode's modular inventory
subject: descent
one_liner: Imported: the completed pair's boost bivector squares to one, generates the atom's unique rotor flow up to reparametrisation, equals $2N - 1$ in Fock representation, runs at $\kappa = 1/4M$ once normalised, and has a $2\pi$ imaginary-rapidity cycle generated outside the real algebra.

title: Imported: time and the plane from modular data
subject: descent
one_liner: Imported: the modular flow of a wedge algebra in the vacuum is the boost (Bisognano-Wichmann), and one half-sided modular inclusion recovers the two-dimensional conformal structure (Wiesbrock).

title: Indifference, structural premise of the series
subject: programme
one_liner: A construction may not carry distinctions that nothing in the framework determines; this is a declared premise of the series, not a theorem.

title: The integer-holographic form, and the identification of the $16\pi$
subject: entropy
one_liner: With the epoch at $\beta$ and in the 1-nat convention, $\nu = 1/16\pi$ is equivalent to $N_{\mathrm{epoch}} = \SBH$, one boundary-mode fermion per four Planck cells of horizon per modular period, and the naive count overshoots by the area coefficient $16\pi$.

title: Intrinsic clock (IC), flagged premise
subject: entropy
one_liner: Premise (IC): the counted epoch is determined by the boundary modes' own dynamics, not by an external choice; read as a Schwarzschild calibration only.

title: The mode count
subject: entropy
one_liner: To leading order in $r_c/2M$, the boundary-mode count over a Killing-time span $\Delta t$ is $N = 8\pi\nu M\,\Delta t/\lP^2$, accruing at the rate $\nu/\TH$.

title: Pair, mode, qubit: one object
subject: tower
one_liner: A tower ladder pair, a fermionic mode and a unit of Witt-index capacity are one object, one qubit of maximal entropy $\ln 2$, and $\Cl(2,4)$ carries exactly two.

title: Principality from indifference: the sphere
subject: entropy
one_liner: Under the indifference principle the boundary modes' $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ structure is the principal embedding, so their bilinear sector is Madore's fuzzy sphere with the round $S^2$ as limit.

title: The residue in each convention
subject: entropy
one_liner: The calibration residue is $\kappa_c = \tfrac14$ in the 1-nat convention and $1/(4\ln 2)$ in the capacity convention, the only one that compares entropy with entropy.

title: The slice volume is exactly $8\pi M$ per unit Killing time, at leading order in $r_c/2M$
subject: interior
one_liner: At the curvature cutoff $r_c = (2M)^{1/3}$ the interior slice volume per unit Killing time is exactly $8\pi M$ at leading order in $r_c/2M$.

title: Blade basis, degenerate forms included
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: For any symmetric bilinear form, degenerate or not, and any basis, the $2^n$ blades form a basis of the Clifford algebra, with structure constants polynomial in the entries of the form.

title: The degeneration sheaf
subject: walls
one_liner: For a corank-one degeneration satisfying the tameness hypotheses, the Clifford fibre at each wall point carries a canonical square-zero ideal of dimension $2^{n-1}$ generated by the radical, with quotient the Clifford algebra of the induced nondegenerate form, and these ideals assemble into sheaves supported exactly on the wall.

title: The determinant identity, and the blow-up expansion
subject: walls
one_liner: Off the wall within the collar, $\det h = \det G \cdot \bigl(-(1 + 2\mu\nu\beta^2 s)\bigr)$ exactly, and $s = 1/\lambda + O(1)$ diverges with the sign of $\lambda$ as the wall is approached.

title: The exceptional algebra of the black hole
subject: singularity
one_liner: After rescaling the dying direction by $\sqrt r$, the Schwarzschild Gram extends to the singularity as $\mathrm{diag}(m^2, -1, -1, -1)$, so the exceptional algebra there is $\Cl(1,3)$.

title: The exceptional algebra: deformation to the normal cone
subject: walls
one_liner: Under tameness, rescaling the dying direction by $1/\sqrt{t}$ along a transversal gives the nondegenerate limit form $G_0|_{V_1} \perp \dot G(k,k)$, of signature $(p,q)$ on the physical side, whose Clifford algebra is canonically independent of the choices.

title: The gauge field and its cometric
subject: singularity
one_liner: In gauge theory gravity the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand Schwarzschild field $\hb = 1 - \beta P$ is invertible at every $r > 0$, fails at $r = 0$, where $\beta$ diverges and the rescaled map $\beta^{-1}\hb$ tends to the rank-one $-P$, whose kernel contains $\er$, null for the limit form (a degeneration through a null kernel direction), and induces the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand line element.

title: The gauge field and its cometric (external ingredients)
subject: singularity
one_liner: The external ingredient of the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand gauge-field fact is the gauge theory gravity background of Doran and Lasenby's textbook.

title: Imported: classification values
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: The real Clifford algebras $\Cl(1,3)$, $\Cl(0,4)$, $\Cl(0,3)$, $\Cl(2,4)$ and $\Cl(1,2)$ are isomorphic to $\Mat_2(\HH)$, $\Mat_2(\HH)$, $\HH \oplus \HH$, $\Mat_4(\HH)$ and $\Mat_2(\C)$ respectively.

title: Imported: classification values (external ingredients)
subject: clifford-structure
one_liner: The classification values draw on the classical classification of real Clifford algebras in Porteous and Lounesto.

title: The infinite wall sequence
subject: walls
one_liner: For a compact wall and good couplings at every stage, the completion iterates indefinitely, giving an infinite sequence of tame shadow walls whose Clifford fibres ascend the Witt tower by one rung per wall.

title: The invariant form of (T3)
subject: walls
one_liner: Given a smooth wall with a smooth corank-one radical line, the differential of $G(k,k)$ along the wall defines a canonical bundle map $\delta : \shL^{\otimes 2} \to N^*\Sig$, and transversality is exactly the demand that it be an isomorphism.

title: Kasner data of the interior
subject: interior
one_liner: Near the Schwarzschild singularity the derived metric of the gravitational field is of Kasner form with exponents $(-\tfrac13, \tfrac23, \tfrac23)$ in proper time $\tau_{\mathrm p} \propto r^{3/2}$; imported as classical.

title: Local freeness at constant rank
subject: walls
one_liner: For any cometric, degenerate or not, the Clifford sheaf is locally free of constant rank $2^n$ with smooth structure functions, so its rank never detects degeneration.

title: Localised transport
subject: walls
one_liner: The degenerate Clifford sheaf embeds canonically in the completed sheaf, and on the wall the radical covector acquires a partner with which it forms a ladder pair that exists exactly over the wall.

title: The metric's residue, and the square-root twist
subject: walls
one_liner: Assuming the wall is tame, the metric has a canonical simple pole whose residue is the inverse of the transversality datum, giving $N^*\Sig \cong \shL^{\otimes 2}$ and making the completion's partner line a square root of the normal bundle.

title: One-sided completion
subject: walls
one_liner: Under tameness, with signature $(p,q)$, $p \geq 1$, on the physical side and a trivial radical line bundle, coupling an adjoined hyperbolic plane to the dying direction gives an ambient form of constant signature $(p{+}1, q{+}1)$ on the whole physical side, wall included.

title: Resolution, ideal-theoretically
subject: walls
one_liner: In any nondegenerate quadratic space containing a wall fibre with its form, the radical line generates the unit ideal of the Clifford algebra.

title: The Schwarzschild degeneration is boundary-tame in $\shW$
subject: singularity
one_liner: In the weighted module at the blown-up Schwarzschild singularity, the derived cometric of the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand gauge field extends smoothly to the boundary and degenerates there with corank exactly one and to exactly first order, with radical $k = \rho + m\,\dtPG$ annihilating the infalling congruence.

title: Tame wall induction
subject: walls
one_liner: Assuming a compact tame wall and a good coupling, the shadow wall is a smooth closed hypersurface along which the ambient form is again a tame corank-one degeneration, so the completion iterates.

title: Tameness
subject: walls
one_liner: A tame corank-one degeneration is one whose degeneracy locus is a smooth closed hypersurface carrying a smooth radical line bundle of corank exactly one, with first-order (transversal) degeneration.

title: The wall Gram
subject: walls
one_liner: On the wall the ambient form splits orthogonally into the surviving directions and a nondegenerate three-dimensional coupled block, giving signature $(p{+}1, q{+}1)$ when $\mu\nu > 0$ and $(p, q{+}2)$ when $\mu\nu < 0$.

title: The weights are forced and are the Kasner exponents
subject: walls
one_liner: Among diagonal rescalings of the Schwarzschild coframe, each prescribed limit at the singularity forces unique weights, and the exceptional weights are the Kasner exponents $(-\tfrac13, \tfrac23, \tfrac23)$ in proper time.

title: The area-law test
subject: entropy
one_liner: Under (C1) to (C3), the boundary-mode capacity equals $\SBH = 4\pi M^2$ at leading order exactly when $\nu\,\Delta t = M/(2\ln 2)$, an epoch of order one Schwarzschild time.

title: Ascended marginals are diagonal
subject: descent
one_liner: Under univalence every single-mode marginal is diagonal in the number basis, hence equal to its descent and, at nonzero weight, a Gibbs state of the boost generator at a unique $\beta_k$.

title: The bosonisation bridge, s-wave sector
subject: thermality
one_liner: Number-conserving bilinears of the boundary fermion modes satisfy free-boson commutation relations exactly, up to a precisely identified edge term on finite windows, and under Premise (Q) they carry Bose-Einstein occupancy at $\TH$ in the s-wave sector.

title: C1: curvature cutoff
subject: entropy
one_liner: Postulate: the boundary mode space lies on the stretched singularity $r_c = (2M)^{1/3}$, where the curvature $2M/r^3$ reaches the Planck value; read as a Schwarzschild calibration only.

title: C2: cell density
subject: entropy
one_liner:
Postulate: the stretched singularity carries $
u$ fermionic modes per Planck cell, with $
u$ a constant whose remaining freedom is the cell calibration; the area law needs $
u = 1/(16\pi\ln 2) \approx 0.029$; read as a Schwarzschild calibration only.

title: C3: counted epoch
subject: entropy
one_liner: Postulate: the Killing-time span counted at one moment is the causal epoch of a single horizon crossing, of order one Schwarzschild time.

title: The causal epoch, computed exactly
subject: entropy
one_liner: For the Schwarzschild field on flat spacetime, the Killing-time span from horizon crossing to the singular locus along the rain worldlines is $2M(\ln\tfrac{1}{\varepsilon} - \tfrac83 + 2\ln 2) + O(\varepsilon)$, of order $M$.

title: $\kappa = 1/4M$, computed
subject: thermality
one_liner: For the Schwarzschild field on flat spacetime the redshifted acceleration of static observers, $v = K/\sqrt f$, is $f'(r)/2$, so the surface gravity is $\kappa = 1/4M$.

title: The cones fold
subject: singularity
one_liner: As $r \to 0$ both radial null directions of the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand metric collapse onto $\er$ while $g(\et,\et)$ diverges, a degeneration through a null kernel direction that no gauge choice removes.

title: The connection bivector, computed
subject: singularity
one_liner: In the Painlev\'e-Gullstrand gauge the connection bivector is exactly $(M/r^2)\,\sigma_r$ along $\partial_t$ and $\sqrt{M/2r^3}\,\sigma_r$ along $\partial_r$.

title: The curvature of the gauge field: exact shape decoupling
subject: singularity
one_liner: The curvature of the black-hole gauge field is exactly $\mathcal{R} = -(M/r^3)\,S$ with $S = 1 - 3\Pi$ a fixed shape operator of spectrum $(-2,-2,1,1,1,1)$.

title: The degeneration, exactly
subject: singularity
one_liner: As $r \to 0$ the rescaled gauge map and metric converge exactly to rank-one limits whose common kernel $\et^{\perp}$ contains the folded direction $\er$, null for the limit form.

title: The descended form is state independent
subject: descent
one_liner: Whatever the ascended state, each descended single-mode marginal is a Gibbs state of the boost generator at a unique $\beta_k$, for every mode of nonzero weight.

title: The descent is the parity average
subject: descent
one_liner: The descent is the parity average $E(x) = \tfrac12\bigl(x + \alpha(x)\bigr)$, the unique conditional expectation onto the even subalgebra, with kernel the odd ladder sector.

title: The descent, and what it erases
subject: descent
one_liner: The descent $E(x) = PxP + (1-P)x(1-P)$, with $P = v^* v$, keeps a mode's diagonal occupation data and erases its coherences.

title: The Euclidean rotor, and where it lies
subject: thermality
one_liner: The imaginary-rapidity continuation $R_{J\theta} = \cos(\theta/2) + J\sigma\sin(\theta/2)$ of the radial boost rotor, $J = e_{2}e_{3}$ the atom's complex unit, has period $4\pi$, with conjugation period $2\pi$, and is realised by no real rotor of $\Cl(1,3)$, in particular not by the curvature-selected pair, whose dual member $I\sigma_r = e_2e_3$ rotates along the bifurcation sphere.
